group_results.reason: This group adds cases to the separately built grapheme test; it changes no library or fuzz-entry behavior.

A terminated input beginning with four 0xff bytes passes the entry guards and supplies a -1 UTF-32 sentinel to a direct STRIPCC normalization call. The changed guard preserves that sentinel. The source also uses -1 as a normalization sentinel; other variants of this change create no additional obligation under D7f.

build.reason: The delegated recipe enables testing and the fuzzing engine, builds the CMake fuzzer target, and copies that target as utf8proc_fuzzer. No changed code is conditional on another build option.

input.reason: A finite NUL-terminated input passes the size and terminator guards. ASCII reaches UTF-8 decoding; four 0xff bytes followed by a terminator reach the direct UTF-32 normalization calls as a -1 word.

lifecycle.reason: The entry frees its copied buffer and returned outputs. Map initializes its output pointer to NULL, frees internal buffers on errors, and returns an allocated output on success; utf8proc_free calls free.

control_flow.reason: After the guards, the entry reaches direct normalization with STRIPCC. Map forwards its options through decomposition and reencoding, which calls normalization; none of the existing map calls supplies the combined CHARBOUND and STRIPCC flags, but direct normalization already reaches the changed sentinel-preservation behavior.
